window.note: Default comparison: the 30 most recent complete UTC days; start inclusive, end exclusive.

central_question: Are NEAR Intents buybacks keeping pace with new NEAR issuance?

usage_correlation.method: Pearson correlation of week-over-week % changes, full 7-day weeks since backfill_from. Descriptive only: no lag, no causality.

verdict.text: Neither Intents volume nor NEAR price leads daily active accounts: no lag of 1–4 weeks is above the noise band on both measures.
Neither Intents volume nor NEAR price leads daily transactions: no lag of 1–4 weeks is above the noise band on both measures.

leading_indicator.method: Week-over-week % changes of Intents volume (DefiLlama) and of the weekly mean NEAR price, at week t, against the change in weekly usage at week t + lag (lag 0–4). Pearson r and Spearman ρ (rank-based, robust to one-off jumps such as 2 Apr 2026). The noise band is ±1.96/√n (about 95%): a lead counts only if both r and ρ are positive and above it. Descriptive, not causal; about 40 weekly points.

wallet.label: revenue wallet listed on revenue.near.org
wallet.confirmed: NEAR's official revenue dashboard lists this account as one of three wallets in its all-time revenue wallet breakdown (with fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near and 1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near).
not_confirmed: That changes in its balance are open-market NEAR purchases (transfers from intents.near do not show the swap itself).
That it is the only wallet receiving buyback NEAR.
Why its on-chain balance differs from the dashboard's all-time figure.
wallet.reason: Balances and net accumulation do not establish purchases or burns. Purchased NEAR held in a wallet is not burned and does not reduce total supply.

related_revenue_wallets.source: Listed alongside the buyback wallet in the same revenue.near.org 'Wallet Breakdown (All-time)' table.
related_revenue_wallets.use: Transfers between these wallets and the buyback wallet move already-captured revenue; they are excluded from the wallet's net accumulation used for coverage (DefiLlama's revenue methodology also excludes transfers between NEAR's revenue wallets).

issuance.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
issuance.method: Σ over epoch boundaries whose first block falls in the period of [total_supply(first block) − total_supply(previous block) + Σ balance_burnt of chunks included in the first block].

reference_cap.note: Protocol maximum, shown for comparison only. Not measured issuance.

daily_issuance.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers

issuance_annualised_rate.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
issuance_annualised_rate.method: Measured period issuance ÷ total supply at period start × 365/30. An observed rate, not the protocol cap.

supply_start.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
supply_start.method: total_supply of block 221760243 (last block before period start).

supply_end.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
supply_end.method: total_supply of block 226227556 (last block before period end).

supply_change.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
supply_change.method: total_supply(end boundary block) − total_supply(start boundary block). Already net of burns; treasury purchases do not change it.

derived_burns.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers
derived_burns.method: Derived: measured issuance − measured supply change over the same period (protocol burns: gas and fees). Not added to supply change again; buybacks are not burns.

epoch_checks.method: Within each epoch supply must not rise (only burns); boundaries must be one epoch apart; each mint should be ≤ and close to supply × max_inflation_rate × epoch duration ÷ 31,556,952 s (ratio < 0.95 or > 1.001 is flagged).

intents_volume.method: NEAR Intents swap volume as reported by DefiLlama. Sum of 30 daily values.

intents_gross_fees.method: Gross fees. DefiLlama: "Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators." Sum of 30 daily values.

intents_net_revenue.method: Net revenue captured after distributions. DefiLlama: "NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded." Sum of 30 daily values.

intents_holders_revenue.method: DefiLlama holders revenue, labelled as buyback money from 2026-02-23. DefiLlama: "Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders." Sum of 30 daily values. A label, not confirmed purchases.

net_revenue_capture_rate.method: Net revenue ÷ swap volume over the period, in basis points (1 bp = 0.0001).

buyback_allocation.method: DefiLlama holders revenue ÷ net revenue over the period. Based on a label, so a proxy for the share used to buy NEAR.

price_avg.method: Mean of daily 00:00 UTC prices in the period.

buyback_proxy_near.source: DefiLlama (protocol slug near-intents) dailyHoldersRevenue ÷ daily NEAR price
buyback_proxy_near.method: Proxy: Σ over days of (DefiLlama holders revenue in USD ÷ NEAR price that day). DefiLlama labels this revenue as buyback money; it is not a confirmed purchase record.

wallet_net_accumulation.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers: view_account, wrap.near ft_balance_of, intents.near mt_balance_of (nep141:wrap.near) for buybacks.multisignature.near
wallet_net_accumulation.method: Change in NEAR held (native liquid + locked, wNEAR, wNEAR inside intents.near, and NEAR delegated to staking pools) between the period boundary blocks. Net accumulation, not proof of purchases.

wallet_internal_transfers.source: NearBlocks transfers between buybacks.multisignature.near and fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near, 1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near
wallet_internal_transfers.method: Inbound minus outbound transfers (native NEAR receipts and wNEAR FT events) between the buyback wallet and the other revenue wallets listed on revenue.near.org.

wallet_net_excl_internal.source: NEAR mainnet archival RPC (https://archival-rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com): block headers: view_account, wrap.near ft_balance_of, intents.near mt_balance_of (nep141:wrap.near) for buybacks.multisignature.near; NearBlocks transfers
wallet_net_excl_internal.method: Wallet net accumulation (archival RPC balances) minus net transfers from NEAR's other listed revenue wallets, so moves between NEAR's own wallets are not counted as new buyback NEAR. Still net accumulation, not proof of purchases.

verified_purchases.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us): intents.near event logs, queried daily (data/bigquery-daily.json)
verified_purchases.method: Lower bound of NEAR bought: wNEAR gained in 3194 token_diff swaps by the accounts that fund the buyback wallet (each counted from the first day it sent NEAR to the wallet), summed over the 30 days (0 NEAR sold). NEAR they received by transfer is not counted, because its payment is not visible in these events.

trace_withdrawn_to_wallet.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us): intents.near event logs, queried daily (data/bigquery-daily.json)
trace_withdrawn_to_wallet.method: Sum of 795 native_withdraw intents to the buyback wallet over the 30 days.

trace_untraced_near.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us): intents.near event logs, queried daily (data/bigquery-daily.json)
trace_untraced_near.method: NEAR delivered to the wallet that is not matched by a swap of the accounts that fund it: it reached them by transfer inside NEAR Intents (see the one-off trace in docs/bigquery-results.json for where it came from).

coverage_verified.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us): intents.near event logs, queried daily (data/bigquery-daily.json); issuance: NEAR archival RPC
coverage_verified.method: Verified NEAR bought (lower bound, daily BigQuery trace) ÷ measured issuance over the same 30 UTC days.

coverage_proxy.method: Proxy: revenue-based buyback estimate (NEAR) ÷ measured issuance (NEAR), same 30 UTC days.

coverage_wallet.method: Net accumulation of the revenue wallet listed on revenue.near.org, excluding transfers from NEAR's other listed revenue wallets, ÷ measured issuance, same 30 UTC days. Not verified purchases.

usage_active_accounts.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us), filtered on block_date: data/bigquery-usage.json
usage_active_accounts.method: Daily active accounts. Mean of 30 daily values: distinct transaction signers per UTC day (transactions.signer_account_id). Compared with the previous 30 days. NearBlocks' own figure for the same days is kept as a cross-check (nearblocks_value).

usage_txns.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us), filtered on block_date: data/bigquery-usage.json
usage_txns.method: Daily transactions. Mean of 30 daily values: transactions per UTC day (rows of transactions). Compared with the previous 30 days. NearBlocks' own figure for the same days is kept as a cross-check (nearblocks_value).

usage_new_accounts.method: New accounts created. Sum of 30 daily values of NearBlocks' "new_accounts" (NearBlocks' definition). Compared with the previous 30 days.

usage_active_contracts.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us), filtered on block_date: data/bigquery-usage.json
usage_active_contracts.method: Daily active contracts. Mean of 30 daily values: distinct accounts receiving FUNCTION_CALL actions per UTC day (receipt_actions.receipt_receiver_account_id). Compared with the previous 30 days. NearBlocks' own figure for the same days is kept as a cross-check (nearblocks_value).

usage_function_calls.source: BigQuery public NEAR dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us), filtered on block_date: data/bigquery-usage.json
usage_function_calls.method: Daily contract calls. Mean of 30 daily values: FUNCTION_CALL receipt actions per UTC day (receipt_actions). Compared with the previous 30 days. NearBlocks' own figure for the same days is kept as a cross-check (nearblocks_value).

simulator.formula: Required daily volume (USD) = daily issuance (NEAR) × NEAR price (USD) ÷ (net revenue capture rate × buyback allocation)
simulator.label: Conditional scenario under the stated assumptions. Not a prediction and not a supply-neutrality threshold.

wallet_transfers.note: Inbound transfers from intents.near are native_withdraw intents from many accounts inside NEAR Intents; they are consistent with NEAR bought there, but transfers alone do not show the swap. Receipt amounts are approximate (NearBlocks floats).

official_dashboard.note: The dashboard attributes captured revenue to wallets; on-chain holdings can differ (other inflows, outflows, timing). Neither figure alone proves purchases.

trace.label: BigQuery, run daily by the refresh workflow: per-day NEAR withdrawn to the wallet and swaps by the accounts that fund it (@start, @end, @wallet, @known = accounts already seen)
trace.code:
-- NEAR Parity daily on-chain buyback trace (BigQuery public NEAR dataset)
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT eo.block_date AS day,
         JSON_VALUE(SUBSTR(l.element, 12), '$.event') AS event, d
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` eo,
       UNNEST(eo.logs.list) AS l,
       UNNEST(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(SUBSTR(l.element, 12), '$.data')) AS d
  WHERE eo.block_date >= @start AND eo.block_date < @end
    AND eo.executor_account_id = 'intents.near'
    AND eo.status NOT LIKE '%FAIL%'
    AND STARTS_WITH(l.element, 'EVENT_JSON:')
    AND (l.element LIKE '%"event":"token_diff"%' OR l.element LIKE '%"event":"native_withdraw"%')
),
wd AS (
  SELECT day, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') AS account, CAST(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.amount') AS BIGNUMERIC) AS yocto
  FROM ev WHERE event = 'native_withdraw' AND JSON_VALUE(d, '$.receiver_id') = @wallet
),
first_wd AS (SELECT account, MIN(day) AS first_day FROM wd GROUP BY account),
eligible AS (
  SELECT a AS account, DATE '1970-01-01' AS from_day FROM UNNEST(@known) AS a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT account, first_day FROM first_wd WHERE account NOT IN UNNEST(@known)
),
sw AS (
  SELECT day, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') AS account,
         CAST(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.diff."nep141:wrap.near"') AS BIGNUMERIC) AS yocto
  FROM ev WHERE event = 'token_diff'
),
d_w AS (SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS withdrawals, SUM(yocto) AS withdrawn FROM wd GROUP BY day),
d_s AS (
  SELECT s.day, COUNTIF(s.yocto > 0) AS swaps,
         SUM(IF(s.yocto > 0, s.yocto, 0)) AS bought, SUM(IF(s.yocto < 0, -s.yocto, 0)) AS sold
  FROM sw s JOIN eligible e ON s.account = e.account AND s.day >= e.from_day
  GROUP BY s.day
),
d_new AS (
  SELECT first_day AS day, ARRAY_AGG(account) AS new_accounts
  FROM first_wd WHERE account NOT IN UNNEST(@known) GROUP BY first_day
)
SELECT CAST(day AS STRING) AS day,
       IFNULL(withdrawals, 0) AS withdrawals, CAST(IFNULL(withdrawn, 0) AS STRING) AS withdrawn_yocto,
       IFNULL(swaps, 0) AS swaps, CAST(IFNULL(bought, 0) AS STRING) AS bought_yocto,
       CAST(IFNULL(sold, 0) AS STRING) AS sold_yocto, IFNULL(new_accounts, []) AS new_accounts
FROM d_w FULL JOIN d_s USING (day) FULL JOIN d_new USING (day)
ORDER BY day

trace.label: BigQuery: NEAR delivered to the buyback wallet, and what the accounts behind it bought (swaps)
trace.code:
-- NEAR Parity · BigQuery check 2: what did the accounts that fund the buyback wallet buy?
-- Window: the dashboard's 30-day UTC window, 2026-10-15 (inclusive) to 2026-11-14 (exclusive).
-- 1. Finds every dip4 native_withdraw intent to buybacks.multisignature.near (the wallet's NEAR inflows).
-- 2. Takes the accounts that signed them and sums their dip4 token_diff (swap) events in the same window:
--    wNEAR gained = NEAR bought, wNEAR lost = NEAR sold, the token they gave up = what they paid with.
-- Amounts are yocto (10^-24) strings, so they are cast to BIGNUMERIC, never FLOAT.
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT eo.block_timestamp_utc AS ts,
         JSON_VALUE(SUBSTR(l.element, 12), '$.event') AS event,
         JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(SUBSTR(l.element, 12), '$.data') AS data
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` eo,
       UNNEST(eo.logs.list) AS l
  WHERE eo.block_date >= '2026-10-15' AND eo.block_date < '2026-11-14'
    AND eo.executor_account_id = 'intents.near'
    AND eo.status NOT LIKE '%FAIL%'
    AND STARTS_WITH(l.element, 'EVENT_JSON:')
    AND (l.element LIKE '%"event":"token_diff"%' OR l.element LIKE '%"event":"native_withdraw"%')
),
wd AS (
  SELECT ts, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') AS account,
         CAST(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.amount') AS BIGNUMERIC) / 1e24 AS near
  FROM ev, UNNEST(data) AS d
  WHERE event = 'native_withdraw'
    AND JSON_VALUE(d, '$.receiver_id') = 'buybacks.multisignature.near'
),
accts AS (SELECT DISTINCT account FROM wd),
sw AS (
  SELECT ev.ts, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') AS account,
         CAST(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.diff."nep141:wrap.near"') AS BIGNUMERIC) / 1e24 AS n,
         REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_QUERY(d, '$.diff'), r'"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*"-') AS paid
  FROM ev, UNNEST(data) AS d
  WHERE event = 'token_diff'
),
m_w AS (
  SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', ts) AS month, COUNT(*) AS withdrawals,
         COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS withdraw_accounts, SUM(near) AS near_withdrawn
  FROM wd GROUP BY month
),
m_b AS (
  SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', ts) AS month,
         COUNTIF(n > 0) AS buys, SUM(IF(n > 0, n, 0)) AS near_bought,
         SUM(IF(n < 0, -n, 0)) AS near_sold,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(n > 0, paid, NULL), ', ' LIMIT 6) AS paid_with
  FROM sw JOIN accts USING (account) GROUP BY month
)
SELECT * FROM m_w FULL JOIN m_b USING (month) ORDER BY month

trace.label: BigQuery: where the rest of their NEAR came from (transfers and deposits, by source)
trace.code:
-- NEAR Parity · BigQuery check 3: where did the rest of the withdrawn NEAR come from?
-- For the same accounts and window as check 2, sums the wNEAR credited to them inside NEAR Intents by
-- nep245 mt_transfer (from another Intents account) and mt_mint (a deposit from outside), by source.
WITH logs AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(l.element, 12) AS j
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` eo,
       UNNEST(eo.logs.list) AS l
  WHERE eo.block_date >= '2026-10-15' AND eo.block_date < '2026-11-14'
    AND eo.executor_account_id = 'intents.near'
    AND eo.status NOT LIKE '%FAIL%'
    AND STARTS_WITH(l.element, 'EVENT_JSON:')
    AND (l.element LIKE '%"event":"native_withdraw"%'
         OR (l.element LIKE '%wrap.near%'
             AND (l.element LIKE '%"event":"mt_transfer"%' OR l.element LIKE '%"event":"mt_mint"%')))
),
ev AS (
  SELECT JSON_VALUE(j, '$.event') AS event, d
  FROM logs, UNNEST(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(j, '$.data')) AS d
),
accts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') AS account
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = 'native_withdraw'
    AND JSON_VALUE(d, '$.receiver_id') = 'buybacks.multisignature.near'
),
credits AS (
  SELECT event,
         COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.new_owner_id'), JSON_VALUE(d, '$.owner_id')) AS to_acct,
         COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.old_owner_id'), 'deposit') AS from_acct,
         CAST(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(d, '$.amounts')[OFFSET(i)] AS BIGNUMERIC) / 1e24 AS near
  FROM ev, UNNEST(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(d, '$.token_ids')) AS tok WITH OFFSET i
  WHERE event IN ('mt_transfer', 'mt_mint') AND tok = 'nep141:wrap.near'
)
SELECT event, from_acct, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(near) AS near
FROM credits JOIN accts ON to_acct = account
GROUP BY event, from_acct
ORDER BY near DESC
LIMIT 15

trace.label: BigQuery: every NEAR flow of the hub account behind most of those transfers
trace.code:
-- NEAR Parity · BigQuery check 4: what does the hub account do?
-- Check 3 found one NEAR Intents account (51e8f94d…) that sent 191,434 wNEAR in 500 transfers to the accounts
-- that withdraw to the buyback wallet. This lists every wNEAR flow of that account in the same 30-day window:
-- swaps (and what it paid with), transfers in (by source), transfers out, deposits and withdrawals.
WITH logs AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(l.element, 12) AS j
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` eo,
       UNNEST(eo.logs.list) AS l
  WHERE eo.block_date >= '2026-10-15' AND eo.block_date < '2026-11-14'
    AND eo.executor_account_id = 'intents.near'
    AND eo.status NOT LIKE '%FAIL%'
    AND STARTS_WITH(l.element, 'EVENT_JSON:')
    AND l.element LIKE '%51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe%'
),
ev AS (
  SELECT JSON_VALUE(j, '$.event') AS event, d
  FROM logs, UNNEST(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(j, '$.data')) AS d
),
sw AS (
  SELECT CAST(JSON_VALUE(d, '$.diff."nep141:wrap.near"') AS BIGNUMERIC) / 1e24 AS near,
         REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_QUERY(d, '$.diff'), r'"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*"-') AS paid
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = 'token_diff'
    AND JSON_VALUE(d, '$.account_id') = '51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe'
),
mv AS (
  SELECT event, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.old_owner_id') AS src, JSON_VALUE(d, '$.new_owner_id') AS dst,
         JSON_VALUE(d, '$.owner_id') AS own,
         CAST(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(d, '$.amounts')[OFFSET(i)] AS BIGNUMERIC) / 1e24 AS near
  FROM ev, UNNEST(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(d, '$.token_ids')) AS tok WITH OFFSET i
  WHERE event IN ('mt_transfer', 'mt_mint', 'mt_burn') AND tok = 'nep141:wrap.near'
)
SELECT flow, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(near) AS near FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT('swap: bought NEAR, paid with ', IFNULL(paid, '?')) AS flow, near FROM sw WHERE near > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'swap: sold NEAR', -near FROM sw WHERE near < 0
  UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('received from ', src), near FROM mv
    WHERE event = 'mt_transfer' AND dst = '51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sent to other accounts', near FROM mv
    WHERE event = 'mt_transfer' AND src = '51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'deposited from outside (mint)', near FROM mv
    WHERE event = 'mt_mint' AND own = '51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'withdrawn (burn)', near FROM mv
    WHERE event = 'mt_burn' AND own = '51e8f94d77b5e90dc9852ca6113771e11e8382ce69473a75e313e41665de7cbe'
)
GROUP BY flow
ORDER BY near DESC
LIMIT 20

weekly.label: The same calculations per 7-day bucket from 2026-02-01 (boundary blocks in data/boundaries.json)
weekly.code:
issuance_week = Σ mint for boundaries in the week
proxy_week = Σ_day holders_usd ÷ price
wallet_week = Δ wallet holdings − internal transfers

usage.label: BigQuery public NEAR dataset, per UTC day (run by the refresh workflow for each new day; filtered on block_date, the partition column)
usage.code:
-- NEAR Parity daily network usage (BigQuery public NEAR dataset)
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT block_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS txns, COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) AS active_accounts
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
  WHERE block_date >= @start AND block_date < @end
  GROUP BY day
),
fc AS (
  SELECT block_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_receiver_account_id) AS active_contracts, COUNT(*) AS function_calls
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions`
  WHERE block_date >= @start AND block_date < @end AND action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL'
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT CAST(day AS STRING) AS day, IFNULL(txns, 0) AS txns, IFNULL(active_accounts, 0) AS active_accounts,
       IFNULL(active_contracts, 0) AS active_contracts, IFNULL(function_calls, 0) AS function_calls
FROM tx FULL JOIN fc USING (day)
ORDER BY day

usage.label: NearBlocks daily network charts (keyless; cross-check, and the 2025 baseline)
Weekly values, the index, and the correlation
usage.code:
active_accounts_week = mean(daily active_accounts)
txns_week = mean(daily txns)
intents_volume_week = Σ DefiLlama daily volume ÷ days
index = value ÷ value(first week from 2026-02-01) × 100
r = pearson(week-over-week % change of volume, of active accounts), full weeks

usage.label: Leading-indicator test (the track hypothesis)
usage.code:
for lag in 0..4:
  r(lag)   = pearson(Δ% volume[t], Δ% usage[t + lag])
  rho(lag) = spearman(same pairs)
  same for Δ% weekly mean NEAR price
lead = lag ≥ 1 with r > 1.96/√n and rho > 1.96/√n
